Spartans came in with a 11% above average attack and a 12% stingier than average defense (4-1, 83.6 scored and 65.2 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 184 and 187 games of evidence. Projected to score 97.2, they scored 91 (−6.2 points, 6% under); projected to allow 56.8, they allowed 70 (+13.2 points, 23% over).

The bigger miss was Titans' scoring (+13.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 161 against 153.9 projected (+7.1), about the 69th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Spartans by 21 against Spartans by 40.4 projected, about the 4th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:

OVER 150.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 150.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 46% of bets on Titans, 50% of the money — Titans covered; total: 72% of bets on the over, 73% of the money — it went over.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Titans, who lost and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.025 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -18.3 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 875 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.981 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Titans attack ×0.971, defense ×1.027 (5 games); Spartans attack ×0.994, defense ×0.995 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 19.4 points), no bet.
